description: Recommendations submitted by the Finance Commission for the year 2027
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the provisions of Article 154 of the Constitution, the Finance Commission is mandated to make recommendations regarding the resources required for the Provincial Councils established as per the 13th Amendment to the Constitution as well as the principles to be followed in allocating grants from the National Budget to each Provincial Council. Accordingly, with the objective of achieving a balanced regional development across the Country, the Finance Commission has submitted its recommendations to the President pertaining to the policies to be followed in distributing funds among Provincial Councils, which are allocated to Provincial Councils from the Annual Budget 2027, as well as the Government interventions required for more efficient delivery of services related to the subjects assigned to the Provincial Councils. The proposal submitted by the President to implement the said recommendations and to submit the same to Parliament, in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (7) of Article 154R of the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.
